title: Playlist Editor + Listener Growth Lead
mission: Create living Spotify playlists with a point of view and help good music earn more real, repeat listening.
positioning: Spotify is the shelf. The work is the room.

compensation.disclosure: Scope, share percentage, eligible revenue, credit, ownership, reporting, payout timing, and exit terms will be agreed in writing before work begins.

outcomes: Authored playlist worlds with a clear premise, sequence, cover language, description, and editorial rhythm
More real listeners choosing to save, share, revisit, and continue into the artists they discover
A repeatable release and maintenance practice connecting artists, communities, editorial, and owned channels
An honest evidence trail showing what traveled, what did not, and what should change next
responsibilities: Define playlist concepts, audiences, settings, and emotional arcs
Research, sequence, edit, credit, and maintain Spotify playlists
Direct covers, titles, descriptions, notes, and shareable launch materials
Build trusted circulation with artists, labels, DJs, music communities, editorial, and owned channels
Read authorized audience signals and turn them into a better next edition
Document the operating rhythm so the work can keep running
success_signals: song and artist saves after discovery
healthy skip, exit, and completion patterns
credible next actions for participating artists

first_90_days.outcome: Audit the field, set an honest baseline, and pitch three playlist worlds.
Launch the strongest concepts with cover systems, notes, circulation plans, and weekly editorial care.
Refine from real behavior and leave a working listener-growth playbook with receipts.

non_negotiables: no purchased streams, followers, saves, comments, or listener impersonation
no bots, click farms, or fake accounts
no undisclosed pay-for-placement or playlist takeovers
no promises of editorial placement outside our control
no guaranteed listener number before the work earns it

application.subject: Role 001 — Playlist Editor + Listener Growth Lead
proof: three songs in order and why they belong together
one playlist you built or wish you had built
an honest example of helping music reach real listeners
one song you would remove from your own sequence and why
